Bruttolön per lönekod, kostnadsställe oc: Gross pay per pay code, cost centre and month, never per person. Small or dominated groups are hidden.
De bokförda raderna: konto, månad, serie: The posted rows: account, month, series, cost centre and project. Every posted voucher counts.
Din roll har inte behörighet till någon: Your role has no access to any of the data sets.
Du ser bara det som hör till de kostnads: You see only what belongs to the cost centres and projects you have access to.
Du ser bara rader på dina egna kostnadss: You see only rows on your own cost centres and projects. Personnel costs (accounts 7000–7699) and payroll bookkeeping are not shown, and other units appear as Other unit.
En post per faktura eller kreditfaktura,: One record per invoice or credit note, without drafts: customer, month, status and kind. Net, VAT, total and unpaid.
Inga poster för valet. Prova en annan pe: No records for this choice. Try another period or remove a filter.
Jämför med samma månader året innan: Compare with the same months a year earlier
Lön visas bara sammanräknad, aldrig per: Pay is shown only added up, never per person. An amount is hidden when any of its parts, per pay code, cost centre and month, covers fewer than :count people or is dominated by one person; totals that contain a hidden part are hidden too.
Raderna i varje räkenskapsårs aktiva bud: The lines of each fiscal year's active budget: account, month, cost centre and project. Forecasts are not counted.
Raderna på kundfakturor och kreditfaktur: The rows of customer invoices and credit notes, without drafts: article, revenue account, customer and month. Net amount.
Raderna på registrerade leverantörsfaktu: The rows of registered supplier invoices, excluding VAT: supplier, account, month, status, cost centre and project.
Tabellen skulle få fler än :count celler: The table would have more than :count cells. Choose fewer rows or columns, or add a filter.
Visar de första :count posterna. Välj et: Showing the first :count records. Make a narrower choice to see more.
Välj uppgifter, gruppera dem i rader och: Choose data, group it in rows and columns and compare periods. Click an amount to see the records behind it.
